sections.title: Study apps
sections.intro: I build these tools alongside my networking, IT support, and algebra coursework. Each runs on its own and saves study progress in the browser.

apps.name: Subnet Sprint
apps.description: Work an IPv4 subnet worksheet or VLSM problem, then use Weak spots to retry the steps you missed.

apps.name: No Shutdown
apps.description: Practice IOS commands, configure simulated devices, or work a Packet Tracer lab one question at a time.

apps.name: Tier One
apps.description: Train for the Windows help desk with lessons, command drills, and support tickets. Missed tickets return to the review queue.

apps.name: Algebra Quest
apps.description: Work through college algebra with generated problems, guided hints, written flashcard recall, and review by topic.
